verdict.rationale: Semgrep is a static code-analysis (SAST/SCA) tool that scans source repositories, not a runtime/data platform where 'production data' vs 'sandbox' distinctions apply; the evidence pack shows only local/offline code scanning (semgrep-gh-2, semgrep-comm-11), which is inherently code-only and never touches production data by design, so the sandbox-vs-production axis is a category mismatch for this product type.
